page.overview:
Who is Saul Bellow?

Saul Bellow (June 10, 1915 - April 5, 2005) is a Canadian-born Jewish American writer.

Bart Simpson told Rabbi Krustofsky that Saul Bellow, the Nobel-prize-winning Jewish novelist, wanted to have lunch with him, in a ploy to get him to reunite with his son. When Hyman came to the restaurant, and after he looked on the menu he told the waitress that she can tell Mr Saul Bellow that he has lost his appetite.
